opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases); most grants awarded are below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, or non-UK-based organisations (exceptional cases may be accepted).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK.
